arguments.message: Hi there! Once you add a new payment method in Settings → Billing → Payment method, our billing team will retry the failed charge and, once it succeeds, lift the suspension. This isn’t instant – the team reviews the new charge and typically restores access within a short window, but the exact timing can vary. Adding the new card a day or two before the next invoice helps ensure it’s used for the upcoming charge.
